mentions.name: BrandGEO
mentions.description: This tool audits how AI engines like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini describe a brand. It runs a 2-minute audit across all 5 major AI engines and tells the user exactly what to fix in their brand's AI presence.
mentions.problem: Manually monitoring and auditing how AI engines describe brands was a repetitive, time-consuming task for the agency and its clients.
mentions.audience: Brand owners checking their own brand and agencies managing their clients' brands
mentions.source_excerpt: I ended up building a tool to do it for us. It is called https://BrandGEO.co, it runs a 2-minute audit across all 5 major AI engines and tells you exactly what to fix.
